episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Seok Ji-won and Yun Ji-won reunite after 18 years, as chairman and gym teacher of the same school.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: At a staff dinner, Seok Ji-won makes a bet with Yun Ji-won over whether the "crazy lilac" will bloom.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Seok Ji-won and Yun Ji-won meet at the pond where they used to go on dates but get into another fight.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Yun Ji-won recalls her past with Gong Moon-su, and Seok Ji-won ruins the inauguration ceremony.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: The two families fight over the golf course, while Yun Ji-won secretly nurses Seok Ji-won's cold.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Yun Ji-won becomes furious when Seok Ji-won forgets their kiss from the night before.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: Seok Ji-won and Yun Ji-won begin dating and discover old letters and texts they had sent each other.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: Seok Ji-won hopes to enjoy a workshop with Yun Ji-won. He gets anxious by the rumors of Gong Moon-su.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.summary: Seok Jiwon and Yun Jiwon's relationship becomes public and starts to cause trouble. Seok Jiwon plans to propose to Yun Jiwon.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.summary: Seok Ji-won continues to plan his proposal, but unexpected situations keep getting in the way.

episodes.title: Episode 11
episodes.summary: Seok Jiwon uncovers shocking facts about Ji Gyeonghun's corruption during his investigation. Yun Jaeho confronts Ji Gyeonghun at his villa.

episodes.title: Episode 12
episodes.summary: The truth behind the incident from 12 years ago is revealed. Yun Jiwon and Seok Jiwon's love blossoms as they prepare for their wedding.
